$comment: Liveness parameters for lib/liveness.mjs. Chosen values, not measurements (author's prompt #13), each with one line on why. Amplitudes are kept well inside rig/rig.json limits so lip sync and emotions can add to them later.

blink.intervalWhy: Chosen: people at rest blink every few seconds; 2 to 6 s keeps a short clip alive without looking nervous.
blink.closedWhy: Chosen: 3 to 4 frames at 30 fps, long enough to read as a blink, short enough not to look sleepy.
blink.doubleWhy: Chosen: about one blink in seven is a double, now and then, not a pattern.
blink.doubleGapWhy: Chosen: eyes open again for 4 to 7 frames between the two closings of a double blink.

breathing.periodWhy: Chosen: about 15 breaths a minute, a calm rate at rest.
breathing.depthWhy: Chosen: 3 px from top to bottom (head y from -1.5 to +1.5), felt more than seen; one tenth of the 30 px shift limit.

micro.segmentWhy: Chosen: a new small head target every 1.5 to 3.5 s, slow enough to read as drift, not as a twitch.
micro.tiltWhy: Chosen: targets within -0.8..0.8 degrees, a fifth of the 4 degree limit.
micro.shiftWhy: Chosen: targets within -4..4 px on each axis, under a seventh of the 30 px limit.

cursor.why: Chosen: the classic terminal cursor rate, 530 ms on and 530 ms off, starting on.
